name: super-orkestra-monorepo
description: Super Orkestra — open-source AI coding orchestrator: one conductor model plans and reviews, three worker models code in isolated git worktrees. Minimal tokens, persistent memory, automatic resume after subscription limits.

scripts.build: npm run build -w super-orkestra-core && npm run build -w super-orkestra -w super-orkestra-vscode -w super-orkestra-desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vscode --noEmit && tsc -p packages/desktop && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test

author: Cuma Bozkurt
